methods.title: Time Series Momentum
verified_summary_facts: Summary describes 58 diverse futures/forward contracts, over 25 years of data, and own prior 12-month excess return as a predictor of future return.
Effect described at monthly/yearly horizons, partly reversing over longer horizons.
methods.limits: Summary-level evidence only. Cannot relabel twelve months as twelve hours or inherit performance into crypto, cash CFDs or intraday prop rules.

methods.title: Trading Costs of Asset Pricing Anomalies
verified_summary_facts: Summary reports nearly one trillion dollars of live institutional equity trading, 19 developed equity markets, 1998–2011.
Authors describe size/value/momentum strategies surviving their costs at institutional capacity, while short-term reversal does not at reasonable size.
methods.limits: Not micro-futures/CFD fees or retail crypto profitability; cannot apply institutional equity capacity estimates to our trades.

methods.title: Dynamic Trading With Predictable Returns and Transactions Costs
verified_summary_facts: Summary explicitly combines expected-return strength, alpha decay, risk/correlation and transaction costs when trading predictor portfolios.
methods.limits: Specific optimal policy formula was not verified from full original; does not justify trading every predictor or every price change.

methods.source_type: original author MIT-licensed implementation and README, pinned code

verified_code_formulas.ex_ante_volatility: EWM daily-return std span60; next-day payoff scaled by0.15/(sqrt252*sigma[t])
verified_code_formulas.MACD_normalization: (EWMAshort−EWMAlong)/rolling_price_std63, then divided by rolling_std252 of that ratio
verified_code_formulas.changepoint_models: One Matern3/2 Gaussian process versus a bounded one-change two-Matern3/2 process, fitted only on trailing completed-return windows.
verified_code_formulas.changepoint_severity: sigmoid(NLML_stationary−NLML_change) for a single fitted comparison; score is not a calibrated probability or p-value
verified_code_formulas.gross_train_objective: negative annualized Sharpe of position*next-day scaled return; no transaction-cost term in legacy SharpeLoss
verified_code_formulas.chronology: ModelFeatures separates years before test boundary into chronological90% train/10% validation, then later test years; real-feature scaler fitted on TRAIN.
verified_code_formulas.example_run: Default1990 training start, annual test starts2016–2020 (range2016,2021), final configured end2022; example uses100 available futures tickers, not paper sample.

audited_limits: Legacy volatility/MACD warmups use backfill from later values; a causal adaptation must remove it and discard full warmup.
First entry turnover cost omitted via diff().fillna(0) with an explicit TODO; terminal liquidation cost also not explicitly charged in inspected cost function.
Some normalized diagnostic returns use realized test-window volatility; cannot use this as deployable ex-ante leverage.
README examples choose tickers partly by data availability throughDec2021, not verified point-in-time historical universe.
Author README sample periods differ between repositories; full original sample and OOS definitions remain unverified.
Daily overnight continuous futures and approximate notional bps costs do not establish cash-CFD execution, actual rolls, prop-hour compliance, margin or payout survival.

methods.source_type: original author MIT-licensed method/code/configs, pinned source

verified_code_formulas.daily_sigma: EWM daily-return std span63 with63 observations minimum, no bfill in new feature builder
verified_code_formulas.cross_asset_context: Directed delay shifts cross-asset hidden states by one completed time step in default lagged architecture; optional staggered-close variants exist.
verified_code_formulas.train_turnover_cost: gamma*(bps_i*1e−4)*abs(position[t]/sigma[t]−position[t−1]/sigma[t−1]); defaultgamma0.5, author estimated half-spread cost schedule
verified_code_formulas.position_output: prediction head bounds positions via tanh; model weights are not integer contract quantities

audited_limits: Original50-continuous-future1990–2025 vendor price panel is absent due licensing restrictions; no empirical run or performance reproduced.
Cost schedule is an author estimate of half-spread, not actual historical prop commissions/slippage; e.g. ES/NQ0.25bps.
Backtest turnover diff().fillna(0) omits each initial entry cost; no terminal liquidation cost charged in inspected function.
Processed next-day target is clipped to±20 times estimated daily sigma; raw realized execution P&L must not be clipped in our account replay.
Published diagnostic return/CAGR/drawdown series are rescaled using realized whole-test volatility to10% annual, not a prospective executable sizing rule.
Daily business-day model uses252 annualization; crypto365-day data and actual calendar-month returns need their own declared conventions.
Public code configurations identify multiple architecture/cost/temperature/seed ablations, not independent economic discoveries or one untouched final hypothesis.
Actual contract rolls, spreads, market depth, integer quantities, margin, prop daily-reset accounting and payout rules remain separate unverified requirements.
